MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document)
WITH p,
     CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) AS birth_day,
     CAST(split(COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14'), '/')[0] AS INT64) AS end_year,
     CAST(split(COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14'), '/')[1] AS INT64) AS end_month,
     CAST(split(COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14'), '/')[2] AS INT64) AS end_day
WITH p,
     end_year - birth_year - CASE
       WHEN end_month < birth_month OR (end_month = birth_month AND end_day < birth_day) THEN 1
       ELSE 0
     END AS age
WHERE age < 78
RETURN p.position AS col1, p.nationality AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

WITH p, CAST(REPLACE(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE) AS birth_date, CAST(REPLACE(COALESCE(p.death_date, '2026/10/14'), '/', '-') AS DATE) AS end_date
